sequenceDiagram
    participant SH as Shoppers
    participant PL as Platform and storefronts
    participant IP as iPaaS order flow
    participant WMS as WMS at Duiven
    participant ERP as ERP
    participant MC as Marketplace connector
    participant MP as bol, Amazon.de, Zalando
    SH->>PL: Ridgewalker orders, up to 38 a minute
    PL->>IP: New orders, one at a time
    IP->>WMS: Create order, throttled to about 7 a minute
    WMS->>WMS: 19:40 last Ridgewalker picked, stock zero
    WMS->>ERP: 19:45 stock snapshot, Ridgewalker zero
    SH->>PL: 19:45 to 20:30 jackets still sold
    MP->>MC: 19:45 to 21:35 jackets still sold
    ERP->>PL: about 20:30 hourly push, Ridgewalker zero
    PL-->>SH: sold out from about 20:30
    PL->>MC: about 21:15 hourly push, Ridgewalker zero
    MC->>MP: about 21:35 listings at zero

flowchart LR
    SH["Shoppers, 60 a minute forecast"] --> PL["Platform checkout, never degraded"]
    PL -->|"order webhook"| OMS["OMS, one order record"]
